description: Turn one test on or off for one target, and set its per-target config and schedule. config replaces the target's config for that test (null clears it; keys are the plugin's own, e.g. {"expectNoindex": true} for robots-txt). scheduleOverride is a cron expression (null returns to the default). Fields left out are unchanged. Team OWNER/ADMIN only. HTTP assertion monitors: testSlug "http-assertions", config {"monitors": [{"name", "url" (absolute, or a path on the target), "method", "headers", "body", "expectStatus", "expectHeaders": [{"name", "contains" | "notContains"}], "bodyContains", "bodyNotContains", "severity"}], "failuresBeforeAlert": 2}; it runs every 5 minutes and raises findings only after failuresBeforeAlert failed runs in a row. A config the test cannot use is refused with the reasons.

config.description: Per-target config for this test; null clears it

enabled.description: Run this test on the target

scheduleOverride.description: Cron expression for this target; null clears it

name: set_target_test
title: Set Target Test
